summary: iter130 P1 Consumer Storefront & Discovery — FULL GREEN on backend + web + mobile. Backend pytest 8/8 pass (test_iter130_storefront_p1.py): GET /api/store/adv_fpk returns brand{name:'FPK', primary:'#0aa54b'} + exactly 7 games + coupons_left_today=2520 + resets_at; /api/store/adv_fpk/scarcity returns per-game remaining_today + aggregate; /api/store/UNKNOWN_ADV_ID -> 404 store_not_found; /api/me/wallet-coupons requires auth (401 unauth) and returns 9 items for demo@ across sources {wallet, saved, game_win}, no BigPoints pollution; /api/admin/fpk/coupon-caps returns totals.daily_cap=2520 with 7 games x 5 tiers (percents [10,20,30,40,50], caps [200,100,40,15,5]) and correctly 401/403s for anon + non-admin (test@). WEB: /store/adv_fpk renders public (no login) with data-testid store-page + store-hero + store-name='FPK' + store-scarcity showing '2,520 coupons left today · 23:30:59' — countdown live-ticks (verified changed 2s later). All 7 game cards store-game-cmp_fpk_{spin,scratch,quiz,mystery,memory,word,card} render with per-game 'store-game-{id}-left'='360 left today' and the whole card is a <Link to='/play/{id}'>. store-view-coupons -> /offers?tab=mine. /offers page: offers-tabs + offers-tab-deals + offers-tab-mine + offers-fpk-store (-> /store/adv_fpk). Clicking My Coupons as demo@ loads mycoupons-grid with 8 owned coupons incl multiple FPK wins (10%/20%/30% + 25% saved). Logged OUT /offers?tab=mine shows mycoupons-error (raw '401' text) — no crash, offers-tabs still visible. /admin/fpk-caps: non-admin (demo@) redirected off route (fpk-caps-page not shown); admin@ sees fpk-caps-page with fpk-caps-totals='Daily cap 2520 / Issued today 0 / Remaining 2520' + 7 fpk-game-{id} blocks + 35 fpk-tier-{prize_id} cards + fpk-caps-scarcity countdown + fpk-caps-refresh works. Landing page (logged OUT /): landing-for-listeners renders at top=1935 BEFORE landing-for-business (2485) and landing-for-advertisers (3125); listener-cta-listen -> /login and listener-cta-play -> /login?demo=1. MOBILE (Expo web preview): demo-login-btn login works -> /home; /coupons renders coupons-tabs + coupons-tab-deals + coupons-tab-mine + coupons-fpk-store banner; tapping the banner navigates to /store/adv_fpk. Mobile storefront has store-page + store-name='FPK' + store-scarcity('2,520 left today · 23:29:08') + store-games with 7 store-game-cmp_fpk_* cards each showing store-game-{id}-left='360 left today' + store-view-coupons. Tapping a Play card (authed) navigates to /game/cmp_fpk_spin ✓. Tapping store-view-coupons navigates to /coupons?tab=mine ✓. My Coupons tab loads mycoupons-list for demo@ (populated). No red-screen, no crashes. Only nits found: (a) spec called the count testID 'scarcity-strip-count' but code uses 'store-scarcity-count' (works fine, just a naming inconsistency vs spec); (b) logged-out /offers?tab=mine on web renders the raw 'Request failed with status code 401' string instead of a friendlier 'sign in to view your coupons' empty state (still passes 'no crash' acceptance); (c) mobile /coupons redirects to /login when unauthenticated instead of showing mycoupons-empty (spec's 'mycoupons-empty with mycoupons-store-cta' path unreachable while logged out because the tab route is auth-gated). None of these are blockers.

integration_issues.issue: Renders raw axios error string 'Request failed with status code 401' inside mycoupons-error instead of a friendlier prompt to sign in. Functional acceptance ('no crash, offers-tabs still visible') is still met.

The /coupons route redirects to /login when unauthenticated, so the spec's mycoupons-empty (with mycoupons-store-cta) empty state is unreachable while logged out on mobile. If the intent is a public 'empty' state, the route needs to unblock rendering + call the API only when authed. Behavior is still graceful (no crash).

parity_issues.issue: Web Play card links to /play/{campaign_id}; mobile Play tap navigates to /game/{campaign_id}. This is per the spec (spec explicitly says web -> /play/{id} and mobile -> /game/{id}), so it's intentional divergence — flagging for visibility only.

action_items: (Nit) Rename testID 'store-scarcity-count' -> 'scarcity-strip-count' to match the spec's naming (or update the spec). Currently CouponScarcityStrip.jsx line 50 emits '${testId}-count' and StorePage passes testId='store-scarcity', producing 'store-scarcity-count'. Spec expected 'scarcity-strip-count'.
(Nit) Replace raw axios error text in logged-out My Coupons on web with a friendlier empty/CTA state (e.g. 'Sign in to view your coupons' + link to /login).
(Nit) On mobile, either allow /coupons to render publicly with mycoupons-empty (+ mycoupons-store-cta -> /store/adv_fpk) when logged out, or drop that acceptance criterion from the spec.
(Optional) Log a friendly redirect from the game card Play tap on mobile when the user is not authenticated (currently silently drops the user on /login without any 'sign in to play' hint).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/storefront.py (348 lines) is well-scoped, uses request.app.state.db, no MongoDB _id leakage in responses, correctly excludes BigPoints-award plays from /api/me/wallet-coupons via the $or on bigcoinAwarded, and lazily rolls over daily_issued when daily_issued_date != today (see _issued_today). No security issues in the admin route (require_admin dependency). Good separation between store_router, me_coupons_router, and admin_caps_router.

Minor: storefront() will still 404 with 'store_not_found' only if BOTH games are empty AND the advertiser record is missing — this is the intended behavior per spec but means an advertiser with no active campaigns yet still renders the branded empty-state instead of 404-ing. Confirmed working as designed; just calling it out.
StorePage.jsx: the entire game card is a <Link to={g.play_route}>, so semantic accessibility (button vs link) is fine; every card has its own testID + a per-card -left testID.
CouponScarcityStrip testID naming ('${testId}-count') diverges from spec's 'scarcity-strip-count' but functionality is intact. Trivial rename.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all acceptance criteria; 3 nits noted (see action_items)
